syncSegmentsEn.text: I do not know what tomorrow holds. Each day I live for the Lord
I will not borrow tomorrow’s sunshine, for tomorrow may be cloudy
I will not worry about my future, for I know the Lord’s promise
Today I will walk with the Lord, for He knows the road ahead
So much about the future I cannot understand today
But I know who holds tomorrow, and I know who holds my hand
Every step grows brighter, like climbing stairs of gold
Each burden grows lighter, and every cloud is clothed in silver
There the sun shines always, and tears will flow no more
At the end of the lovely rainbow, the mountains meet the sky
So much about the future I cannot understand today
But I know who holds tomorrow, and I know who holds my hand
So much about the future I cannot understand today
But I know who holds tomorrow, and I know who holds my hand
I know well who holds tomorrow
And I know who holds my hand
